All tests pass and typecheck/build are clean.

Refactored the SSG into a plugin architecture:

- `src/plugin.ts` — `Plugin` interface (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile(page)`, `onEnd`) and `createPipeline` running every hook across all plugins in order.
- `src/plugins/markdown.ts` — `MarkdownPlugin` (markdown → HTML).
- `src/plugins/template.ts` — `TemplatePlugin` (template engine + page/index rendering).
- `src/plugins/dev-server.ts` — `DevServerPlugin` (HTTP + websocket live reload + watcher).
- `src/config.ts` — loads `ssg.config.ts` (and `.js`/`.json` fallbacks), resolves user plugins from `./plugins/`.
- `src/generate.ts` — core engine `buildSite` now orchestrates the pipeline via `setupBuild`/`runBuild`.
- `src/server.ts` — `serveSite` delegates to `DevServerPlugin`.
- `src/index.ts` — exports the plugin system and built-in plugins; existing exports unchanged.
